messages:
maria: Hey team — need two approvals on a Terraform PR that wires a GKE node pool into the GPU subnets. Plan looks straightforward but this touches egress routes + node taints/labels. Can we get reviewers for a midday canary? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8421

jordan: linking in a quick question — does this include the workload SA IAM binding for the node pool? also can you paste the plan output for the route changes so I can eyeball potential calc of disrupted flows?

maria: good call. it does add a small iam binding for the node service account. plan snippet below (relevant lines):
```
Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ module.gke_gpu_node_pool.google_container_node_pool.this will be created
~ google_compute_route.gpu-egress will be updated (diff 1 line)
```

sam: tiny nit — can you add the node label `workload=hf-inference` to the taint/label block? autoscaler + scheduling rely on that selector for inference pods. otherwise LGTM from infra perspective.

maria: ack — adding that label now, will push a commit in a sec.

lee: I can review but not until ~2pm PT. if you want faster, @jordan or @sam are good.

jordan: happy to take first pass. quick question on canary scope — propose scheduling a 5% traffic slice to the new nodes for 15m, observe latency/cost, then expand if healthy. thoughts?

maria: that works. planned canary steps:
1) apply TF in canary mode (targeted node pool creation)
2) cordon a small subset of inference deployment replicas onto the new nodeSelector: `kubectl patch deployment inference-api -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"labels":{"canary":"gpu-v1"}},"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"workload":"hf-inference"}}}}}'`
3) run smoke test + check tracing/latency for 15m
4) revert selector or roll out to 100%

also adding the exact rollback/apply commands here: 
```bash
# create only node pool module
terraform apply -target=module.gke_gpu_node_pool -var-file=secrets.tfvars
# to revert (if we need to remove):
terraform destroy -target=module.gke_gpu_node_pool -var-file=secrets.tfvars
```

ops-bot: CI: all checks for PR #8421 passed — plan, fmt, and terratest success :white_check_mark:

jordan: looked through the plan and the route diff is minimal — nothing that looks like it will route prod traffic incorrectly. LGTM from me after sam's label is added. :thumbsup:

sam: saw the new commit, label present. LGTM — one small doc nit about the canary rollback steps in the PR description but not blocking.

lee: gave it a pass, small styling nit about variable naming — pushed a suggestion. once that's in, LGTM from me.

maria: pushed the var rename and doc update. thanks all. scheduling merge for 12:30 PT today to align with our oncall window. please only merge when you see the canary apply window is free.

deploy-bot: Merge: PR #8421 merged by maria at 12:31 PT. Canary apply started, monitoring watchers notified.

maria: thanks everyone — will monitor metrics and post a short update in #incidents if anything odd shows up. :rocket:
